### Mandatory Five-Source Rehydration Audit
1. `live_handover_current_baton`: Restored from [`AGENTS.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/AGENTS.md). Ordinary Diary canonical cancellation consumer convergence accepted at `bfac65298e1d4aaca85d1c9dcb20329ef298c485`.
2. `current_authority_allocation`: GPT Sol is Conductor/integrator/acceptance owner; DeepSeek V4 Flash/high via Claude Code `--bare` is implementation/test worker (declined for this orientation tranche); Gemini 3.7 Flash/high via Antigravity is independent veto reviewer.
3. `active_plan_and_acceptance`: Verified [`docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation-plan.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation-plan.md), [`docs/security/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation-threat-model-delta.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/security/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation-threat-model-delta.md), [`docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-post-cancellation-programme-orientation.md), and register revision 347 [`docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-347.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-347.md).
4. `protected_evidence_boundaries`: Holdouts v1–v10 sealed, provider lane paused, historical diary ignored, product authority backend-owned, no live routes/databases/providers/protected refs/Pages touched, `docs/branding/` and unrelated untracked files preserved.
5. `git_refs_and_worktree`: Exact worktree `C:\Users\sarashera\EMR4-worktrees\post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5`, branch `codex/review-post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5`, HEAD `74da22d5372299eb2d2e38bb2266b76c89a97035`, clean before and after verification.

---

### Challenge Responses & Verification Findings

1. **Exact Git & Worktree Verification:**
   - Preflight and postflight `git status --short --branch` (C01, C07) confirm branch `codex/review-post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5` and clean worktree.
   - `git rev-parse HEAD` (C02) confirms exact hash `74da22d5372299eb2d2e38bb2266b76c89a97035`.
   - File diff against parent `5981b6cacdd3d488462803748c0d86f1e9bc2457` touches only orientation docs, threat model delta, test files, latch, register revision 347, and inbox receipts. No product source or protected refs modified.

2. **First-Party UI Representation of Arrival:**
   - In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/diary/diary.js), the ordinary Diary Expected flow list uses generic status transition to `Arrived` (`renderFlowList("flow-list-expected", filteredExpected, "Check In", "Arrived")` and `setAppointmentStatus(a, targetStatus, null, waitingAreaId)`).
   - In [`docs/diary/meta-grid.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/docs/diary/meta-grid.js), Reception One's console supports only `["status", "time", "duration", "practitioner", "cancel"]`, with `Arrived` available through general status selection.
   - Neither first-party client consumes or exposes the A5.1 check-in route.

3. **Dedicated A5.1 Route Posture:**
   - In [`app/config.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/app/config.py), `rayleen_a5_check_in_enabled: bool = False` and `rayleen_a5_check_in_synthetic_practice_ids: str = ""` ensure the feature is default-off and practice-allowlisted.
   - In [`app/routers/appointments.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/app/routers/appointments.py), `/proposals/check-in/{appointment_id:uuid}` and `/proposals/check-in/confirm` exist, gated by `_a5_check_in_gate_open(current_user)`, supporting atomic waiting-area assignment, audit recording, patient-free `checked_in` event emission, and idempotency receipts.

4. **Static Action Grammar, Route Contract & Promotion Discrepancies:**
   - [`app/services/diary/action_grammar.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/app/services/diary/action_grammar.py) marks `DiaryActionVerb.check_in` as `implemented=False`, `confirm_actions=()`, with notes that no signed confirm action exists.
   - [`app/services/diary/action_route_contract.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/app/services/diary/action_route_contract.py) classifies `check_in` as `RouteAuthority.planned_not_implemented`, mapping proposals to the generic status proposal route.
   - [`app/services/diary/planned_action_promotion.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/app/services/diary/planned_action_promotion.py) requires resolving whether a dedicated signed check-in confirm action or an explicitly reviewed status-confirm binding should be promoted.
   - These repository facts prove a genuine lifecycle posture inconsistency across runtime, UI, and static contract layers that requires reconciliation before wider admission.

5. **Exhaustiveness of Retained Outcomes:**
   - The report defines three distinct architectural outcomes:
     1. Future canonical A5.1 check-in (decoupling the reusable deterministic kernel from the Rayleen-specific default-off gate);
     2. Retaining generic status-confirm as the explicitly documented canonical check-in binding with A5.1 remaining a gated proof;
     3. Specialized atomic status-plus-waiting-area command with a strict non-overlap rule.
   - The report correctly preserves all three options without prematurely choosing among them.

6. **Out-of-Scope & Horizon Boundaries:**
   - Link-patient is identity-sensitive and lacks a signed command family; it is not dependency-satisfied.
   - External patient channels, delegation, Context Fabric durability, and UI polish are properly distinguished and retained as separate horizons.

7. **Successor Scope Boundedness:**
   - The selected successor tranche (`raisa-provider-free-read-only-arrival-check-in-command-family-convergence-review`) is strictly read-only and explicitly prohibited from modifying `app/**`, `docs/diary/**`, API Spine schemas, migrations, or product tests.

8. **Classification of Six Baseline Endpoint Coverage Failures:**
   - In [`tests/test_diary_action_route_endpoint_coverage.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/post-cancellation-orientation-74da22d5/tests/test_diary_action_route_endpoint_coverage.py), the 6 baseline failures are caused by `{appointment_id}` in static route contracts vs `{appointment_id:uuid}` in FastAPI mounts.
   - The orientation report correctly classifies this as pre-existing baseline negative evidence rather than candidate regression, and properly avoids editing static contracts or tests within this orientation tranche.

9. **Evidence Purity & Isolation:**
   - No backend, API, OpenAPI, schema, service, migration, database, provider, or UI source was altered.
   - All changes are confined to orientation, threat model delta, test coverage, latch, error register revision 347, and inbox receipts.

10. **Command Manifest Execution:**
    - C01 through C07 executed sequentially with exit code 0.
    - 118 pytest unit and orientation checks passed (C03).
    - Error register generation passed (C04).
    - Ruff linting on new and modified Python files passed (C05).
    - Git diff whitespace/syntax check passed (C06).
    - Post-execution working directory is clean on the exact candidate commit (C07).

---

### Conclusion
The candidate report faithfully and accurately documents the bounded arrival/check-in lifecycle inconsistency, preserves baseline negative evidence, adheres to all protected boundaries, and selects the narrowest safe next read-only convergence review. The veto passes without reservation.
